desc: Knitted Beanie: a lumpy hand-knit woolly beanie in mustard and brown, a bit too small for the big ogre head, a little square patch sewn on the side. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible
Straw Sunhat: a frayed old straw sunhat with a wide floppy brim and a faded ribbon, one ear poking out through a hole torn in the side. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible
Paper Crown: a crown folded from an old torn WANTED poster, the poster's printing visible on the paper, sticky tape holding a corner. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible
Faded Bandana: a faded red bandana with white dots, tied pirate-style over the top of the head, the knot at the back. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible

Mismatched Earmuffs: big fluffy earmuffs, one muff pink and one muff blue, on a WIDE metal band that arches over the very top of the ogre's big round skull from one ear to the other. Each muff sits right ON one of the ogre's ears, at the far left and far right sides of its head, covering that ear; the face, cheeks and eyes stay completely uncovered. The ogre's head is broad: the band is as wide as the whole head
Bucket Helmet: a dented old tin bucket worn upside down as a helmet, its handle hanging at the side, a little rust. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible
Tea Cosy Hat: a knitted woolly tea cosy in bright stripes with a pom-pom on top, worn as a hat, a hole where the spout would go. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible

Deputy's Trapper Hat: a cosy woolly trapper hat in brown with fluffy ear flaps hanging down, a small shiny tin sheriff's star pinned on the front. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible
Colander Helmet: a dented metal kitchen colander full of little holes worn upside down as a helmet, its two side handles sticking out. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible
Propeller Beanie: a patchwork-coloured beanie made of mismatched fabric panels with a little plastic propeller on top. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible
Long Johns: one-piece red woolly long underwear with a row of buttons down the front and a mismatched patch sewn on the belly
Grandma's Cardigan: a chunky hand-knit cardigan in moss green, the buttons done up in the wrong holes, a big brown patch sewn on each elbow
Cook's Apron: a big white cook's apron over a simple shirt, stained with sauce and gravy, a ladle tucked in its front pocket
Yellow Rain Poncho: a bright yellow crinkly plastic rain poncho, the hood down around the neck, raindrops beading on it
Hand-Me-Down Tunic: a too-small simple adventurer's tunic in faded green with a rope belt, the seams bursting at the shoulders over the big ogre body
Patched Leather Vest: a worn brown leather vest over a grubby shirt, covered in sewn-on cloth patches of all colours and shapes, a shiny little tin star pinned among them
Patchwork Quilt Cape: a big colourful patchwork quilt worn over the shoulders as a cape, tied at the neck with a bit of string, over plain pajamas
Merit Sash: a green scout sash worn across the chest over a plain shirt, covered in round embroidered merit badges with silly pictures: a pillow, a club, a fish, a mug, a moon
Patched Hoodie: a big baggy grey hoodie, far too long in the sleeves, covered in mismatched colourful patches sewn on with big stitches, the hood down
Knee-Patch Dungarees: brown work dungarees rolled up at the ankles over a striped t-shirt, a mismatched square patch sewn on each knee
Big Spoon: a huge wooden cooking spoon the size of a club, held up in the fist, licked clean
Teddy Ogre: a well-loved little stuffed toy ogre, worn and patched, one button eye, held tenderly in the fist
Patchwork Kite: a diamond-shaped kite sewn from colourful mismatched patches with a ribbon tail, held up by its string in the fist
Broken Umbrella: a black umbrella with a few broken spokes flopping, held up over the shoulder in the fist
Mug of Cocoa: a big chunky mug of hot cocoa with marshmallows floating on top, steam curling up, held in the fist
Rubber Duck: a squeaky yellow rubber duck, a little chewed, held up in the fist
Bindle: a long wooden stick carried over the shoulder in the fist, a red spotted handkerchief bundle tied to its end
Patch Kit: a big needle with a long thread held up in the fist, a cloth patch half sewn and dangling from the thread
Campfire Clearing: a cosy forest clearing at night, a crackling campfire with a cooking pot hanging over it, logs to sit on, tall pines and a starry sky
Messy Bedroom: a cosy ogre's bedroom, clothes and socks on the floor, a too-small bed with a patched quilt, a window with moonlight, a half-eaten snack on the table
Laundry Line: a sunny grassy yard with a washing line strung between two trees, patched clothes and big socks drying in the breeze, a wicker basket below
Market Stall: a little wooden market stall with a striped awning in a village square, its table piled with junk, patches, old hats and trinkets for sale
